Adams is best known for his previous role as Tripp Dalton on *Days of Our Lives* (2017–2024), where he earned two Daytime Emmy nominations. He took over the role of Noah Newman after Rory Gibson, who played the character from 2021 to 2023 before leaving for *General Hospital*.
